scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students for studying in India
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian national
Applicant must belong to OBC as notified by the respective State/UT
Applicant must be permanently settled in the State/UT to which they belong
Applicant must be pursuing post‑matriculation or post‑secondary courses in a recognized institution
Applicant must have passed a recognized Matriculation, Higher Secondary or any higher examination
Combined annual income of applicant and parents/guardians must not exceed Rs 1.5 lakh
Restriction applies to a maximum of two boys per the same parents/guardian (not applicable to girls)
Applicant cannot hold any other scholarship or stipend concurrently under this scheme
No subsequent failure will be condoned except for courses in Group ‘A’, and course change after admission is not allowed
Post‑graduate medical courses are eligible only if the student does not practice during the course period
Correspondence course applicants are eligible only for reimbursement of non‑refundable fees and a Rs 900 annual book allowance
Scholars receiving coaching from pre‑examination training centres are not eligible for a stipend
benefits_summary: Provides a maintenance allowance (varying by course group) along with reimbursement of tuition, registration and other compulsory fees, and additional allowances for blind students, study tours, and thesis printing.
